== Summary ==
Identified: [[Robbie Hendon]] (center). Remaining faces unlabeled.
During a Top 8 match. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).
